title: Formalizing Austin Election Results
summary:
*   **Election Results Verified:** The City Council held a special meeting to officially count and verify the returns from the General Election held just two days prior, on April 3, 1965.
*   **Confirming City Leadership:** This crucial procedural step was necessary to formally certify the winners of the recent election, establishing Austin's next elected officials.
*   **Dedicated Session:** This was a focused meeting solely for the purpose of election canvassing, with no other policy discussions or public hearings on the agenda.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 5th day of
April, 1965, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 2:00
P.M. for the purpose of canvassing the Returns of the General Election held on April 3,
1965. s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
ATTEST:
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
s/ Lester E. Palmer
Mayor
City of Austin, Texas
CONSENT TO MEETING
We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purpose therein stated. s/ Travis LaRue
s/ Emma Long
8/ Ben White
s/ L. F. Shanks
